C248  Overlapping lesion of biliary tract (neoplasms involving both intrahepatic and extrahepatic bile ducts)
C249  Biliary tract, NOS

**Note:** TNM is not defined for this schema. If directly assigning Summary Stage 2000 (SS2000), use the *Gallbladder, Other Biliary, and Biliary, NOS* chapter on page 110 of the [SS2000 on-line manual](https://seer.cancer.gov/tools/ssm/ssm2000/SSSM2000-122012.pdf#page=110).
